home.label: Software engineer & technical lead
home.description: JP Melanson builds mobile apps, web platforms and the cloud underneath them. 15+ years, startups to Fortune 500, from Lévis, QC.
home.heroTitle: Hi, I'm JP. I build software that ships — <mark>and stays shipped.</mark>
home.heroSub: Fifteen years of mobile apps, web platforms and the cloud underneath them, for teams from two people to Fortune 500. I like small teams, clear goals and boring infrastructure.
home.intro1: I'm JP, a software engineer and technical lead near Québec City. For 15+ years I've built <mark>mobile apps</mark>, <mark>web platforms</mark> and the <mark>cloud plumbing</mark> underneath them — for startups, a research hospital (CRIUCPQ), a real-estate platform I co-founded, and Ticketmaster.
home.intro2: I'm most useful where product, design and engineering meet: I'll sit with you to figure out what's worth building, then <mark>build it</mark>, then make sure it <mark>stays up</mark>. Day to day that's Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript and Postgres; Go, Rails, Java and AWS when the job calls for them.
home.intro3: I work with small and mid-size teams in tech, real estate, finance and Bitcoin — as your <mark>first engineer</mark>, a <mark>fractional CTO</mark>, or the person who finally migrates the thing everyone's afraid to touch.
home.ctaSub: Thirty minutes, no slides. Bring the problem; I'll bring questions and, usually, a first plan.

resume.name: Jean-Philippe Melanson
resume.overviewText: Software engineer with 15+ years across mobile, web and cloud. Next.js, React, React Native, TypeScript and Postgres day to day; Go, Rails, Java, Scala and AWS when the job needs them. Track record: platform migrations that cut maintenance cost by 60%, ticketing microservices that handled millions of transactions, and one company built from zero as technical co-founder. Comfortable owning a system end to end — architecture, delivery, operations — and working directly with product and leadership.
